convergence_observed.external_termination: Stopped at iteration 116 of the 6000 requested. The host had 63 MB of free memory and had swapped heavily; the container itself was using only 97 MB of its 3 GB limit and one core at full load, so this is host resource exhaustion, not a solver or setup failure. The case ran at roughly 0.15 iterations per second against 4.6 for the same mesh under Spalart-Allmaras, which is a thrashing signature rather than the cost of two extra transport equations. Retained as UNCONVERGED and excluded from every reported quantity.
